title: How do you write numbers between two big numbers?
description: Harpreet puts flags along a village road between two distances. The video finds three numbers between them by changing the hundreds.
teaching_notes: One idea: keep the same thousands, change the hundreds, then check against both ends. Watch for a number that is smaller than the first end.

video_script.why: The child compares two big numbers but has not yet named numbers that lie between them.
video_script.substitution: Keep the shared leading digits, change the hundreds, and check each number against both ends.
video_script.anchor: Harpreet putting up flags along a village road between two marked distances
video_script.wrong_answer: twelve thousand, three hundred is between them
video_script.wrong_move: Chintu picks twelve thousand, three hundred because the hundreds digit three is the first number's hundreds digit. That number is smaller than twelve thousand, three hundred and fifty, so it is not between.
video_script.payoff_line: twelve thousand, four hundred is between them

final_answer.spoken: twelve thousand four hundred, twelve thousand five hundred and twelve thousand seven hundred

never_show: the your-turn answer: any three of 31,300 to 31,800
maths_rules: first number 12,350 and last number 12,800 both start with 12 thousand, so the hundreds decide
hundreds digit of 12,350 is 3 and of 12,800 is 8
12,300 < 12,350, so 12,300 is not between them (the slip)
12,450 and 12,600 also lie between them; many answers are right
your turn: between 31,240 and 31,900 any number from 31,241 to 31,899 fits, such as 31,300, 31,500, 31,800; never shown
video_script.design: One idea: a number between two numbers is bigger than the first and smaller than the last. Wrong idea: pick a number that is below the first end. The road with flags stays as the anchor.

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book.
<bookmark mark='flags'/>Harpreet is putting up flags along a village road. The first flag stands at twelve thousand, three hundred and fifty metres.
<bookmark mark='last'/>The last flag stands at twelve thousand, eight hundred metres.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Name three places for new flags between the first flag and the last.

beats.on_screen: the anchor holds still and gets an accent underline

marks.stop: the anchor is underlined in the accent colour

narration: <bookmark mark='stop'/>Stop the video. Say your answer out loud.

beats.on_screen: a line from 12,350 to 12,800; the 12 thousand part of each number glows; the hundreds digits 3 and 8 light up; a bar below reads bigger than the first, smaller than the last

marks.same: the 12 thousand part of both numbers glows
marks.dig: the hundreds digits 3 and 8 light up

narration: <bookmark mark='same'/>Both numbers start with twelve thousand.
<bookmark mark='dig'/>That means only the hundreds can tell them apart.
<bookmark mark='hund'/>The first number has three hundreds, and the last has eight hundreds.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>A number between them must be bigger than the first and smaller than the last.

beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 12,300; 12,300 is placed on the line left of the first flag; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

marks.low: 12,300 is placed on the line to the left of 12,350
marks.strike: the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The hundreds can be three too, so twelve thousand, three hundred is between them.
<bookmark mark='low'/>Twelve thousand, three hundred is smaller than twelve thousand, three hundred and fifty.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A flag there would stand before the first flag.

beats.on_screen: 12,400 is placed on the line; 12,350 < 12,400 < 12,800 is written; 12,500 and 12,700 join it; the answer card shows 12,400, 12,500 and 12,700

marks.pay: 12,500 and 12,700 appear on the line and the answer card shows the three numbers

narration: <bookmark mark='four'/>Try twelve thousand, four hundred.
<bookmark mark='chk'/>It is bigger than twelve thousand, three hundred and fifty, and smaller than twelve thousand, eight hundred.
<bookmark mark='pay'/>Twelve thousand, four hundred is between them. Twelve thousand, five hundred and twelve thousand, seven hundred are between them too.

beats.on_screen: 12,600 and 12,450 join the line; the words many answers are right appear

marks.many: the words many answers are right appear

narration: <bookmark mark='six'/>Twelve thousand, six hundred also fits, and so does twelve thousand, four hundred and fifty.
<bookmark mark='many'/>Many answers are right, because many numbers lie between two numbers.
